TOOL_STARTED must commit with beginEffectTx before physical tool dispatch. Projection failure before dispatch rolls back and performs zero physical calls. STARTED is logical dispatch, not physical IO proof.

Current real session CAS authorizes event append; historical effect epoch is provenance only. Original canonical run/task and durable RUN_STATE association determine historical session; ambiguous or sealed associations cannot grant authority or lose trusted reconciliation.

Host tool identity is deterministic and explicitly distinct from SDK identity; parent_tool_call_id remains null without actual parent facts. Preserve UNKNOWN then a separate trusted late result, and map run_check nonzero/timed_out to FAILED.

USAGE derives once per immutable ledger entry. Unknown/model reservation money remains null in event and retained in ledger; SDK placeholder zero never settles model cost. Actual local TOOL zero may be known.
Artifact refs require exact validated raw bytes, base64 decoding and hashes; missing raw evidence remains absent. Recovery cannot invent empty output.
Bounded historical ledger repair uses original run association, including after session advances. No token streaming, nested parent, LIVE or full W05 acceptance claim arises from this slice.
